_comment: Run template for synthetic-heat-pump (generated by CAMBER, no real building): a small building's heat pumps at the trend's own 5-minute resolution. heatpump_defrost counts reversing-valve changes per day on the air-source units (warn at 24, fault at 48); hp_mode_vs_need and hp_capacity_shortfall judge each unit's occupied hours against its own setpoints (the air-source units' mode from the compressor and the valve, the water-source units' from the discharge air against the zone); hp_room_imbalance compares the units that share a room, declared below as topology (each unit's parent is its room: nothing in a trend says which units share a room); compressor_staging counts stage changes per day while running on the water-source units (warn at 24, fault at 48); source_loop_deltat reads the loop's delta-T while it pumps (10 F design). Measured: ASHP__defrost_sensor faults on heatpump_defrost (50.0 a day; ASHP__defrost_timer passes at 23.43, just under the limit); WSHP__stuck_heating faults on hp_mode_vs_need; ASHP__no_aux_heat faults on hp_capacity_shortfall (its defrosts read as heating, so hp_mode_vs_need passes it); ROOM_B faults on hp_room_imbalance (62.12% fight); WSHP__stage_hunting warns on compressor_staging (43.3 a day); LOOP__loop_flat faults on source_loop_deltat. Resampled to 15min the defrost and stage counts are floors and most verdicts decline to info: keep resample at 5min.
